_about: TASKS 169 (the user, 3 Nov 2026: 'Ja, eens met allebei'): chain 35's seed 2 had its best inner validation at its epoch cap (200 of 200; decision 51: a re-run). Seed 2 alone, chain 35's recipe and inputs with --epochs 500 (the user: so early stopping, patience 20, ends it and not the cap) and --holdout-twins keep (chain 35 trained before the twin drop), under its own prefix; chain 35's weights are only read. The new seed must have trained on chain 35's inputs, read from the two training records (probes/epoch_repeat_check.py; the training is not bit-reproducible, so the epochs past the first are drift, not a test), then the clean hold-out (a) read of chain 35's seeds 0 and 1 with the new seed 2 (v1.3.1) beside v1.3's (probes/holdout_a_clean.sh). Carried only if worse on neither hold-out (decision 57), by hand after the read.
